title: Cristoc Bonethug
summary: Face Cristoc Bonethug and his five mercenaries during the bard prequest.
overview: Face Cristoc Bonethug and his five mercenaries during the bard prequest.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare control for six opponents and finish the encounter before idle cleanup.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Lantaric Dar's quest interaction summons Cristoc.
Cristoc immediately creates five Bonethug mercenaries.
Cristoc and the mercenaries each have a thirty-minute out-of-combat despawn timer that stops while engaged.

notes: Approval E393. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
